sahneler.metin: Boeing's uncrewed Starliner reached space but couldn't get to the station.
Suddenly, it began burning fuel as if it were far later in the mission.
It had read the time from the rocket at the wrong moment.
The spacecraft used too much fuel to reach its target.
The docking had to be cancelled.
Tests had not run the full mission end to end.
Boeing reworked its software testing before flying again.

aciklama:
Starliner OFT failed to reach the space station. The cause: the spacecraft pulling its elapsed-time clock from the rocket at the wrong point.
